title: card-loop implement result v1
description: Stage `implement` (design D4 card items; CLAUDE.md rules 18/28, DSL-first). The worker authored or audited ONE card's YAML DSL spec and its DebugRunner behavioral tests in its worktree; the driver reads the diff from the worktree, not from this result. `files`: repo-relative paths created or changed. `tests`: test names added or relied on. `test_result_lines`: the verbatim cargo `test result:` / pytest summary lines observed (honesty contract: pasted, never paraphrased; empty if no test was run). `gaps`: DSL vocabulary (`dsl`, qa/dsl-vocab-gaps.md) or engine primitives (`engine`, docs/RUST_ENGINE_GAPS.md) the card needs and the substrate lacks; a non-empty list parks the card on those gap ids (no approximations). Schema is strict-mode compatible: every property is required.

files.description: Repo-relative paths created or modified (YAML spec, behavioral test, registrations).

test_result_lines.description: Verbatim summary lines from the test runs, e.g. `test result: ok. 4 passed; 0 failed; ...`.

gaps.description: Missing substrate; non-empty => the card is PARKED on these ids.

id.description: Stable gap id (existing tracker id when one exists).

notes.description: Anything the reviewer must know; empty string if none.
